verification_rule: IMPLEMENTED/ADDRESSED means code or schema exists on the named draft branch. It is not VERIFIED until the configured runner executes the mapped tests successfully.

controls.statement: Household tranche principal must reject NaN and +/-Infinity before entering maturity or funding calculations.
Observed settlement fee amounts and exported decimal amounts must reject NaN and +/-Infinity before federation serialization.
Project money, cash-flow, FX exposure, hedge and risk values must reject NaN and +/-Infinity before project export or screening.
A commitment digest must be bound to an allowed logical-domain/schema pair so the same bytes cannot be reinterpreted as a different financial object type.
